reasons: Cited Sections 18.1–18.2 meet or exceed the preferred position: CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber/privacy USD 5M, workers' compensation as required by law, coverage through term plus one year, and certificates on request.

Vendor-side obligation is correctly directed (Vendor maintains coverage for Customer's benefit); the noted softeners ('where commercially customary', 'to the extent available from its insurer') attach to terms the playbook does not require, so no redline is warranted.
Consistent with the compliant status, no redline or comment was proposed and the deterministic check confirms an insurance obligation is present.
